name: Zulrah
dataSource: Monster statistics: OSRS Wiki via bundled monsters.json. Strategy notes: OSRS Wiki Zulrah/Strategies.
validationNotes: Per-form DPS (including the 50 damage cap and melee immunity) is covered by reference validation. The share of the kill spent on each form depends on the rotation and on how quickly you kill; the plugin weights the three forms equally, which is an assumption, not a measurement.

requirements.text: Regicide started far enough to reach Port Tyras

warnings: Zulrah cannot be hit with melee (halberds excepted). Only ranged and magic strategies are offered.
Zulrah's attacks and the snakelings apply venom: bring anti-venom or wear a serpentine helm.
Hits above 50 are re-rolled to 45-50; this is included in the DPS figures.

strategies.name: Magic + ranged switches
strategies.description: Magic against the green and red forms, ranged against the blue form. Switch items are carried in the inventory.

inventory.reason: Ranged boost for the blue form
Magic boost for the green and red forms

strategies.name: Ranged only
strategies.description: One ranged setup for every form. Much weaker against the red form, which has very high ranged defence.

strategies.name: Magic only
strategies.description: One magic setup for every form. Much weaker against the blue form, which has very high magic defence.
